units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 4:21">Targ. Jud. IV, 21</cite>, sq.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Gittin 32a:1">Gitt. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ ס׳ וכ׳</he> even the peg in the wooden partition becomes loose (from the heat).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 112a">Snh. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>תלי בס׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="O00540"><he>סיבטא</he></cite>) it hangs on a peg; <cite ref="Arakhin 7b:3">Arakh. 7ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 53a:19">Erub. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>ואנן כי ס׳ וכ׳</he> for us (the labor of impressing traditions on our memory is) like driving a peg into the wall.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38a:9">Ab. Zar. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>דשדי ס׳ לאתונא</he> who threw a tent pin (or a coulter, v. infra) in the stove (to let it dry); <cite ref="Shabbat 74b:4">Sabb. 74ᵇ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:3:13">Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ</cite> <he>בס׳ איתעריית</he> she remained hanging on a projecting peg (in the well).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 386:7">Yalk. Ex. 386</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00861"><he>סִירְתָּא</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. m. <he>סִיכֵּי</he>, <cite ref="O00893"><he>סִכֵּי</he></cite> (from <cite ref="O00639"><he>סִיכָּא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:1">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> top <he>ז׳ ס׳ וכ׳</he> seven pegs from seven bridges, v. <cite ref="C01424"><he>גִּשְׁרָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 69a:12">B. Bath. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>דנקיטי בס׳</he> when the door frames are fastened with pegs (easily removable); a. e.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 80b:8">Yeb. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ דיקנא הוה ליה</he> he had single prickly hairs in his beard.
